name: schema-teams-desktop
description: Настольное приложение Schema Teams для Windows

scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build-renderer.mjs && node scripts/build-config.mjs && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && node scripts/build-notification-state.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:e2e
